name: Dragnet
summary: Rural southern NSW/NE Vic ISP (DragNet Internet Services Pty Ltd, ACN 073 567 781; first POP Junee 1996, base later Albury/Wodonga); dialup then ADSL/satellite/wireless; acquired by Enterprise IT Global 2011 (which went into administration Sep 2011); customer base sold to EFTel ~2013.

events.details: Operating since April 1996 (first POP Junee NSW).
Customer base sold to Eftel (satellite business kept separate); deregistered 2015, ABN cancelled 2017.
